title: Evaluating Certificate Policy - Certification Practice Statement of Unique Government Certification Authority using Public Key Infrastructure Assessment Guidelines: Research in Progress
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical assessment and compliance of Certificate Policy and Certification Practice Statements for a Government Certification Authority against PKI standards and guidelines (e.g., RFC 3647, TSPCCA). It does not involve evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics in a philosophical or societal context.
